summary.en: The margin’s copy block slides on the hop’s ease to stay level with the region in play, the level tick with it.
summary.zh: 页边文案块沿光带跳动的缓动滑到新高度，始终与当前区域齐平，刻度随之移动。

fits: A light or a push that moves the region in play while its words stay beside it.
notFor: Copy that does not belong to a region; a block that would leave the safe area.

intent.en: Word and evidence are read across one horizontal, even when the evidence moves.
intent.zh: 文字和证据始终在同一水平线上读，即使证据移动了。

content.en: A copy block (value, line, note) and the heights of two regions.
content.zh: 一组文案（数值、说明、注释）和两个区域的高度。

fits.zh: 光带或推近移动了当前区域、而文字要留在它旁边时。

notFor.zh: 不属于某个区域的文案；会移出安全区的文案块。

pairs.note: the band hops and the block rides with it

en: Clamp the block to the safe area; a region near the edge leaves the block at the clamp.
zh: 文案块要夹在安全区内；区域贴边时文案块停在边界。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
